soundLibrary.usedBy: Plays during setup and the Guided Tour

moments.tap: Plays when you press a button.
moments.select: Plays when you pick a choice.
moments.next: Plays when you go on to the next screen.
moments.back: Plays when you go back a screen.
moments.toggleOn: Plays when you switch something on.
moments.toggleOff: Plays when you switch something off.
moments.success: Plays when something finishes well, like a check that passed.
moments.commit: Plays when you confirm a big step, like creating your Project.
moments.open: Plays when setup or the Guided Tour opens.
moments.close: Plays when setup or the Guided Tour closes.
moments.pickup: Plays when the Guided Tour picks something up to move it.
moments.drop: Plays when the Guided Tour puts something down.
moments.finish: Plays when you finish setup or the Guided Tour.
moments.cheer: Plays when a helper on the stage cheers for you. Each helper has its own note.
moments.celebrate: Plays with the confetti when your Project is made.
moments.chapter: Plays when you reach a new part of setup or the tour. It gains one note each time and is complete when you are ready.
moments.reveal: Plays when more details or extra fields open.
moments.sheet: Plays when a panel slides open.
moments.phase: Plays as each step of a longer job is ticked off.
moments.found: Plays when setup finds what it was looking for.
moments.warn: Plays when something needs a second look.
moments.copy: Plays when text is copied for you.
moments.move: Plays as the highlight steps from one item to the next.
moments.callout: Plays when a Guided Tour tip appears.
moments.pointer: Plays as the Guided Tour's pointer sets off to show you something.
moments.arrive: Plays when the Guided Tour's pointer reaches what it is showing you.
moments.checkpoint: Plays when you finish a step of the Guided Tour.
moments.missing: Plays when the Guided Tour cannot find the part it wants to show. In NieR Mode the screen tears for a moment.
moments.interrupt: Plays when you stop a demonstration and take over.
moments.reboot: Plays with the NieR bands that start and end the Guided Tour.
moments.decode: Plays as a NieR title appears letter by letter.
moments.save: Plays the moment your Project is saved.
moments.quest: Plays when a NieR card says you finished a part of setup or the tour.
moments.nierOn: Plays while NieR Mode switches on and checks itself.
moments.nierOff: Plays while NieR Mode switches off.
moments.hover: Plays as the NieR menu cursor moves onto a choice.
moments.wake: Plays as the NieR look opens up after you switch NieR Mode on.
moments.string: Plays as a puppet's string pulls tight, and for each letter of your Project's name.
moments.land: Plays when a puppet or a prop is set down on the stage.
moments.showPointer: Plays while Pod 042 takes control to show you something.
moments.showInterrupt: Plays when Pod 042 hands control back to you.
moments.step: Plays when a NieR goal card appears while NieR Mode's Menu sounds are off.
